claim.text: By 1 August 2026, the same Penang line was quoting 22 weeks. That is a four-week improvement in eight weeks, which sounds modest until you annualise it. Then on 15 September 2026, the number came in at 18 weeks. So from 1 June 2026 to 15 September 2026, we went from 26 weeks to 18 weeks, a cut of 31%, while capacity grew from 11,000 units to 16,000 units a month. That is eight weeks of lead time gone in fifteen weeks of calendar time. I have been doing this for eleven years and I have never seen a packaging queue compress that fast without a demand shock behind it.
